title: The old Luthjen's burning; playing there briefly
summary: The old place burned around New Year's; he played there briefly with Billy and Paul.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: The old place burned down about a year ago, Christmas week, I think, about New Year's.
The old stuff burned down there,
The old lady was burned up.
Well she couldn't move, she was an infant like this, that's how she went to. And he must have went home full of liquor or something, I mean he went in bed, I mean that's how he caught a fire.
Yeah, it's funny, wasn't it? Did you ever play at the old place?

Yeah, I played down there with Billy and you did. I didn't stay down there long. I didn't stay down there long. And I played down with Paul, Paul, Paul, Paul, Emilio Bon. I played down there a while, not long though.
